tagline.en: Vchitect's controllable long-video model — image-to-video with depth and trajectory control, built on Wan2.1.
tagline.zh: Vchitect 推出的可控长视频模型——基于 Wan2.1 的图生视频,支持深度与轨迹控制。

en: LongVie is a controllable long-video generation model from Vchitect. It starts from an image and extends it into longer video, and accepts control signals — depth maps and motion trajectories — so you can guide both the content and the movement of the result.

It is built on the canonical Wan2.1 components: the Wan model, its text encoders and VAE, and VACE-style control roles, run through a shared staged diffusion runner. This LongVie-1 route uses the control-weight path and preserves the official segment size, history/noise continuation state, VRAM management, and optional ring/ulysses sequence-parallel controls.
zh: LongVie 是 Vchitect 推出的可控长视频生成模型。它从一张图片出发,将其延展为更长的视频,并接受控制信号——深度图与运动轨迹——从而让你既能引导内容、也能引导结果中的运动。
它构建在标准的 Wan2.1 组件之上:Wan 模型、其文本编码器与 VAE,以及 VACE 式的控制角色,并通过共享的分阶段扩散 runner 运行。这条 LongVie-1 路径使用控制权重路径,保留了官方的分段尺寸、历史/噪声续接状态、显存管理,以及可选的 ring/ulysses 序列并行控制。

whenToUse.en: Choose it when you want long video generated from a starting image with explicit control over depth or motion trajectory — useful when you need the output to follow a specified structure or path rather than free-running.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想从一张起始图片生成长视频,并需要对深度或运动轨迹进行显式控制时可以选它——适用于希望输出遵循特定结构或路径、而非自由发挥的情形。

notFor.en: The run relies on staged checkpoints and only executes the checkpoint-backed GPU path when you explicitly request it, so prepare the weights and enable execution first.
notFor.zh: 运行依赖已准备好的 checkpoint,且只有在你显式请求时才执行由 checkpoint 支撑的 GPU 路径,请先准备好权重并启用执行。

en: Controllable long-video generation from an image
Built on canonical Wan2.1 components and a staged diffusion runner
zh: 从图片出发的可控长视频生成
支持深度控制与轨迹控制的生成
基于标准 Wan2.1 组件与分阶段扩散 runner
可选 ring/ulysses 序列并行控制
